transcript.text: Good morning. Let's get started with the maintenance-priority board. I need current constraints from each of your sections regarding generator G-7, water purification unit W-2, and clinic refrigeration bank R-1. As you know, we have one compatible replacement controller available, and it can go on only one system today. S-4, maintenance chief, medical logistics officer — please give me your sections' situations so we can determine the right allocation before I sign the work order.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to bring something to the board's attention. S-4 confirmed this morning that W-2 has a compatible on-hand spare filter assembly that will keep the purifier operational for seven days, so W-2 does not require the scarce replacement controller today. The inventory adjustment is recorded in the logistics system, but it had not yet been brought to the priority board until now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to put G-7 on the board as critical. The maintenance inspection found that G-7's controller is failing and must be replaced today. The installation takes exactly four hours and can be completed from 1200 to 1600. I have to note that this inspection result is still in the shop worksheet and has not yet been entered in the battalion work-order summary, so it wasn't visible to the board until now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report on clinic refrigeration bank R-1. R-1 is currently operating within limits. I confirmed with the medical depot this morning that its compatible controller is backordered until exactly 18 June. That backorder notice has not yet been attached to the maintenance action record, so it wasn't visible to the board until now.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Scheduled maintenance action for G-7 controller replacement, 1200-1600 today, signed by Maj. Alvarez on the maintenance action record.
R-1 remains operational within limits; monitor daily and expedite installation when backordered controller arrives on 18 June.
W-2 sustained by on-hand spare filter assembly for seven days; reassess at next priority board if controller still needed.
